notes: The editor's gloss «- يعني ابن جعفر -» is left out; «إسماعيل» is the name as the chain writes it.
«عمرو» is written bare in the text (no nasab); the lexicon's «عمرو بن دينار» in the source claims is not in the text and is not used.
Umar's own words («اللهم بين لنا في الخمر») are the saying, so Umar is the last link.
